title: SafetyHub
description: A full-stack makerspace certification management system developed at Purdue University College of Engineering.
highlights: Designed a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to model training prerequisites and validate certification eligibility.
Built role-based access control and searchable administrative certification dashboards.
Tracked student affiliations across 50+ schools and departments.

caseStudy.problem: Manage makerspace safety training, prerequisite eligibility, and tool certifications across students, staff, and mentors.
caseStudy.solution: A multi-level certification system with authorized issuance, role-based permissions, affiliation tracking, and searchable records.
decisions: A Directed Acyclic Graph models prerequisite relationships.
contributions: Led the design and development of the platform.
Implemented certification eligibility, administrative dashboards, and affiliation tracking.
impact: Designed for a potential user base of 7,000+ Purdue students and staff.

title: Berea Bazaar
summary: A marketplace built for the Berea community.
description: A Berea-exclusive marketplace built and deployed in 24 hours, with college-authenticated access and student-focused buying and selling.
highlights: College-authenticated access and secure data handling.
Refined AI-generated components through iterative prompt engineering.

caseStudy.problem: Provide a college-exclusive place for students to buy and sell.
caseStudy.solution: A deployed marketplace with authenticated access and student-focused features.
decisions: Used V0 by Vercel to accelerate development.
contributions: Built and deployed the platform in 24 hours.

title: AI Flash Cards
summary: Study with spaced repetition and generative AI.
description: A full-stack flashcard web app that uses the Google Gemini API to automatically generate study cards.
highlights: Integrated the Google Gemini API for study-card generation.

caseStudy.solution: A full-stack flashcard application with spaced repetition and automated card generation.
contributions: Built the application using React, Flask, and MySQL.
